verdict.rationale: Segment documents Reverse ETL, which extracts warehouse data using a query you provide and syncs it to third-party destinations. That covers model-style definitions on existing warehouse tables and their activation without re-collecting the data. The pricing page also mentions unifying warehouse data into profiles. However, the documented Audiences are built from events and traits that Segment itself tracks, not defined directly on warehouse tables. missing for 10: evidence of audience building directly on warehouse tables (warehouse-native/composable audiences), documentation of model definition and sync scheduling details, independent or hands-on corroboration.
